name: Magnific
summary: AI creative suite (formerly Freepik) for image upscaling, generation and editing, video, audio, 3D and stock assets.
description: Magnific is an AI creative platform with an image upscaler and enhancer, image and video generators and editors, audio tools (music, voice, sound effects), 3D scene and mockup generators, and a library of 250M+ stock photos, videos, vectors and PSDs. It also offers MCP and plugin integrations, Magnific for ComfyUI and credit-based API access.
contains: AI image, video and audio model access (Magnific One, Nano Banana, Kling, Veo, ...)
250M+ stock photos, videos, vectors and PSDs
3D scenes, 3D generation, 3D 360, mockups and icon generator
MCP, plugins and Magnific for ComfyUI
plans: Free, Premium, Premium+ and Pro Starter
